title: PCSO’s STL operators elevated to world standards

blocks.text: Small Town Lottery (STL) operators of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) were elevated to world standards through exposure to international best practices in responsible gaming, player protection, digital innovation, and operational resilience, as well as strategies to address emerging industry threats, combat illegal gambling, and strengthen transparency and accountability. This comes as PCSO, together with STL operators, participates in the World Lottery Summit (WLS) 2026 in Sydney, Australia, which brings together lottery executives, regulators, and industry leaders to exchange knowledge, explore emerging innovations, and discuss solutions to challenges confronting the global lottery industry.
